source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Am I looking at the machine alone, or is the base attached here? The two rectangular slots along the bottom resemble spouts to me, but what are the circles above them? I assume the two holes on top are whisk adjusters; what is the third smaller hole? Also, where will the power button be located?

routing_warnings.description: The proposed replacement of the current switch with a rendering-matched button concerns the power control's visual design rather than whether user-operated power switching is required.
The requested clarification concerns the appearance and proposed replacement style of the power button, not the functional power-switching behavior.
Lighting around the power button is decorative lighting evidence rather than a change to functional startup and shutdown control.
